lines.en: I head over to the library to see what Futaba is doing and, like always, she’s reading. Because that's what you do in a library.
lines.zh: 我去图书馆看 Futaba 在做什么，不出所料，她在看书。毕竟在图书馆里本来就该干这个。

lines.en: Unless you're me. If you're me, you suck the life force out of everyone you encounter and convert it into sexual energy which you then inject back into someone via penetrative sex.
lines.zh: 除非你是我。换成我的话，就是把遇到的每个人的生命力吸干，转化成性欲，再通过插入式性交注回某个人体内。

lines.en: And there is a high likelihood that penetrative sex will occur today because Futaba hates herself even more than I do. Which is awesome because it means I finally get a win.
lines.zh: 而今天发生插入式性交的可能性相当高，因为 Futaba 比我还讨厌她自己。这可太棒了，因为这说明我总算赢了一回。

lines.en: Her attention switches to me as she believes I'm more interesting than any sort of book she could ever pick up, but she quickly finds out that I have the depth of a half-written synopsis.
lines.zh: 她把注意力转向我，觉得我比她能拿起的任何一本书都有意思；但她很快就发现，我的深度只相当于一份写了一半的内容简介。

lines.en: Frankly, I'm not sure how it took her this long to realize that. So I'll just go ahead and assume she was distracted by my dick in her mouth.
lines.zh: 说实话，我不明白她怎么花了这么久才意识到这点。那我就姑且当她是嘴里含着我的鸡巴分了心吧。

lines.en: I wind up asking Futaba about how her journey as a writer is going because it {i}is{/i} something I'm genuinely interested in. And I hope she makes it further than I ever did.
lines.zh: 最后我问起 Futaba 写作这条路走得怎么样，因为我是{i}真心{/i}在意这件事。我希望她能走得比我远。

lines.en: I just hope she understands that proceeding down this path means she'll have to spend more time with her feelings. And if her feelings are anything like mine, that's dangerous.
lines.zh: 我只希望她明白，走这条路意味着她得花更多时间和自己的感受待在一起。而如果她的感受跟我的差不多，那可就危险了。

lines.en: It might be why I stopped writing in the first place. But that memory is buried so far beneath mountains of shit and meat that I doubt I'll ever be able to confirm it.
lines.zh: 也许这就是我当初不再写作的原因。可那段记忆早被埋在成山的屎和肉底下，我怀疑自己这辈子都没法确认了。

lines.en: Regardless, I'm glad she has a few new avenues to use when it comes to expressing herself.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我很高兴她有了几条新的途径来表达自己。

lines.en: I just hope they aren't all dead ends.
lines.zh: 我只希望它们不会全是死胡同。
